easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
